p: sing of the mercies of the: Though the horrible confusion of things might cause them to despair of God's favour, yet the manifold examples of his mercies cause them to trust in God though to man's judgment they saw no reason to.
said: As he who surely believed in heart.
establish in the very heavens: As your invisible heaven is not subject to any alteration and change: so shall the truth of your promise be unchangeable.
I have made a covenant with: The prophet shows what the promise of God was, on which he grounded his faith.
heavens shall praise thy wonders: The angels will praise your power and faithfulness in delivering your Church.
sons of the mighty can be: Meaning, the angels.
saints: If the angels tremble before God's majesty and infinite justice, what earthly creature by oppressing the Church dares to set himself against God?
Thou rulest the raging of the: For as he delivered the Church by the Red sea, and by destroying Rahab, that is, the Egyptians, so will he deliver it, when the dangers are great.

Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in: Tabor is a mountain west from Jerusalem, and Hermon to the East, so the prophet signifies that all parts and places of the world will obey God's power for the deliverance of his Church.
Justice and judgment are the habitation: For by this he judges the world and shows himself to be a merciful father and faithful protector to his.
know the joyful sound: Feeling in their conscience that God is their father.
countenance: They will be preserved by your fatherly providence.
glory of their strength: In that they are preserved and continue, they should give the praise and glory to you alone.
defence: In that our King has power to defend us, it is the gift of God.
thy holy one: To Samuel and to others, to assure that David was the chosen one.
mighty: Whom I have both chosen and given strength to execute his office, as in Ps 89:21.
beat down his foes before his: Though there will always be enemies against God's kingdom yet he promises to overcome them.
mercy shall be with him: I will mercifully perform my promise to him despite his infirmities and offences.
horn be exalted: His power, glory and estate.
rivers: He will enjoy the land around him.
father: His excellent dignity will appear in this, that he will be named the son of God and the firstborn in which he is a figure of Christ.
for ever: Though for the sins of the people the state of the kingdom decayed, yet God reserved still a root till he had accomplished this promise in Christ.
Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not: Though the faithful answer not in all points to their profession, yet God will not break his covenant with them.
alter the thing that is gone: For God in promising has respect to his mercy, and not to man's power in performing.
witness in heaven: As long as the Sun and Moon endure, they will be witnesses to me of this promise.

made void the covenant of thy: Because of the horrible confusion of things, the prophet complains to God, as though he did not see the performance of his promise and thus discharging his cares on God, he resists doubt and impatience.

crown by casting it to the: By this he means the horrible dissipation and tearing of the kingdom which was under Jeroboam, or else by the Spirit of prophecy Ethan speaks of those great miseries which came to pass soon after at the captivity of Babylon.
youth hast thou shortened: He shows that the kingdom fell before it came to perfection or was ripe.
LORD: The prophet in joining prayer with his complaint, shows that his faith never failed.
how short my time is: Seeing man's life is short, and you have created man to bestow your benefits on him, unless you hasten to help, death will prevent you.
bosom the reproach of all the: He means that God's enemies not only slandered him behind his back, but also mocked him to his face and as it were cast their injuries in his bosom.
thine enemies have reproached: So he calls them who persecute the Church.
footsteps of thine anointed: They laugh at us who patiently wait for the coming of your Christ.
